incident.title: L train: Canarsie Tube closed
incident.report: Signal fire in the Canarsie Tube. No L service between Bedford Av and 8 Av in either direction until further notice.

plans.label: 1 Av ↔ Astor Pl + Bedford Av ↔ Metropolitan Av/Lorimer St

advisory.text: Take the M to 14 St/6 Av. About 33 minutes, step-free.
Take the L to Metropolitan Av/Lorimer St, then take the G to Court Sq-23 St, then take the E to 14 St/8 Av. About 41 minutes.
Take the L to Myrtle-Wyckoff Avs, then take the M to Broadway-Lafayette St/Bleecker St, then take the 6 to 14 St-Union Sq. About 45 minutes.
Take the L to Broadway Junction, then take the A to Fulton St, then take the 4 to 14 St-Union Sq. About 52 minutes.

findings.text: During L train: Canarsie Tube closed, the G overloads first: Greenpoint Av to 21 St reached 244% of capacity at 8 a.m.
Elevator to the L platform at Myrtle-Wyckoff Avs out of service; M platform elevator works.
Elevator to the L platform at 14 St-Union Sq out of service.
The Jay St-MetroTech to Fulton St shuttle carried 1,560 riders an hour, 93% of plan, using the Brooklyn Bridge bus lane.
The Bedford Av to Marcy Av shuttle carried 1,650 riders an hour, 79% of the 2,100 planned: buses queued on the Williamsburg Bridge approach.
During the L closure, Metropolitan Av/Lorimer St G platform crowding hit the safety limit 26 minutes in; the G needed 2 more trains an hour.

episodes.summary: Tomás: about 52 min, 2 transfers: L Canarsie-Rockaway Pkwy → Broadway Junction (6 stops), then A Broadway Junction → Fulton St (6 stops), then 4 Fulton St → 14 St-Union Sq (2 stops).

Maya: about 45 min, 2 transfers: L Morgan Av → Myrtle-Wyckoff Avs (3 stops), then M Myrtle-Wyckoff Avs → Broadway-Lafayette St/Bleecker St (9 stops), then 6 Broadway-Lafayette St/Bleecker St → 14 St-Union Sq (2 stops).
Dev: about 41 min, 2 transfers: L Bedford Av → Metropolitan Av/Lorimer St (1 stop), then G Metropolitan Av/Lorimer St → Court Sq-23 St (4 stops), then E Court Sq-23 St → 14 St/8 Av (8 stops).
Aisha: about 33 min, 0 transfers, step-free: M Myrtle-Wyckoff Avs → 14 St/6 Av (11 stops).
PLAN-MVB8W8KN published: 1 Av ↔ Astor Pl. The rider desk has the handoff.
Remembered F-MVB8WA9S: During L train: Canarsie Tube closed, the G overloads first: Greenpoint Av to 21 St reached 244% of capacity at 8 a.m.

PLAN-MVB8W9Q4: 1 Av ↔ Astor Pl at 25 buses an hour (1,750 riders); Bedford Av ↔ Metropolitan Av/Lorimer St at 60 buses an hour (4,200 riders); 26 buses on the road. Riders with no path 4,689 → 623; max-flow shortfall 1,266 → 315; fastest-path overflow 24,078 → 28,762 riders an hour (riders who had no path now travel and add load downstream).

PLAN-MVB8W8KN: 1 Av ↔ Astor Pl at 25 buses an hour (1,750 riders); 8 buses on the road. Riders with no path 4,689 → 623; max-flow shortfall 1,266 → 315; fastest-path overflow 24,078 → 28,762 riders an hour (riders who had no path now travel and add load downstream).

Shuttle candidates: 1 Av → Astor Pl (1,266 riders an hour with no open line, 0.8 km, 6); 1 Av → 8 St-NYU (1,266 riders an hour with no open line, 0.9 km, W/R); Bedford Av → Metropolitan Av/Lorimer St (relief for 4,038 riders an hour, 0.7 km, L/G); Bedford Av → Nassau Av (relief for 4,038 riders an hour, 0.9 km, G); Metropolitan Av/Lorimer St → Hewes St (relief for 1,643 riders an hour, 0.8 km, M/J).

23,445 displaced riders an hour. If each takes the fastest open path, 4 segments overflow by 24,078 riders an hour: G Greenpoint Av → 21 St at 244%; G Nassau Av → Greenpoint Av at 201%; G 21 St → Court Sq-23 St at 198%; 4,689 have no open path. If riders are spread perfectly (max flow, forward peak direction), the open network can carry 17,167 of 18,432 (93%); 1,266 cannot move. Min cut is at the riders' own stations: 1 Av (1,266) have no open alternative.

23,445 riders an hour had trips crossing the closure (2,021 origin-destination pairs). Within 1 stop of it: 10,142 riders at 23 stations; within 4 stops: 14,713 at 90 stations; 2,698 more start further out. Largest origin: Bedford Av (4,038).
Opened INC-MVB8W6YR. Closed 10 L segments across 6 stations (Bedford Av → 1 Av → 3 Av → 14 St-Union Sq → 14 St/6 Av → 14 St/8 Av). At 8 a.m. the busiest closed segment carried 18,086 riders an hour.

Resolved: Bedford Av → Bedford Av (L) [120]; 14 St/8 Av → 14 St/8 Av (A,C,E,L) [618]; L → route L.

handoffs.note: Plan published. Tell every remembered rider whose trip crosses the closure what to take instead.

playbooks.title: Canarsie Tube closure
steps: Close the L between Bedford Av and 8 Av in both directions.
Measure what the J/M/Z and G can absorb toward Manhattan.
Bridge Bedford Av to Marcy Av with buses; plan for 80% of nominal bus capacity.
Add G trains if Metropolitan Av/Lorimer St is in the min cut.
